info.name: HandCO API
info.description:
Full /api/v1 collection for H&CO ecommerce. All client-facing ids are **rids**. Spec fields productId/addressId are rid strings.

Import HandCO.local environment and set baseUrl. Run folder scripts or Flows under postman/flows/.

request.description: Returns the Google consent `url` and an encrypted `state` (valid 10 minutes). Saves state to oauthState.

Exchange the Google authorization code (from the web client callback URL) for HandCo tokens. Run "OAuth Google URL" first, sign in at the returned url, then copy `code` from the redirect into the googleAuthCode variable. Codes are single use and expire in minutes.
